title: Visa Applications
notes: Migrated list/detail/new pages onto ListPage/DetailPage archetypes; added a real edit page (previously missing). Traveller and destination country now use RelationCombobox (fixes #53); status now correctly defaults to not_started on create (fixes #52). Dashboard rebuilt on design tokens. sendMessageDialog not wired — visa has no messaging affordance in the original app and no contact/phone data on the record to drive it. GET /visa/missing-documents remains orphaned (#112, no Kanban view — out of scope for this pass, would need a KanbanBoard rebuild).
showcaseScript: Open the Visa dashboard and see applications by stage
Create a visa application for a traveller
Tick off checklist items and upload a document
